# FlareText

`Flare.Components.FlareText`

Renders a semantic HTML element (h1-h5, p) styled with the active theme's type scale. Uses BuildRenderTree to support dynamic element names - standard Razor cannot do this.

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Align` | `TextAlign` | `TextAlign.Default` | Parameter |  | Horizontal text alignment. Default inherits the surrounding alignment. |

| `Color` | `FlareColor` | `` | Parameter |  | Text color. Role (FlareColor.Primary) -> shared class; custom (FlareColor.Custom("#...")) -> inline token. Default inherits. |
| `Element` | `string?` | `` | Parameter |  | HTML element to render (e.g. "h1".."h5", "p", "span"). When null a sensible default for the Typo is used. |

| `Weight` | `FontWeight` | `FontWeight.Default` | Parameter |  | Font weight override. Default keeps the type scale's weight. |
